bio.text: James Uthmeier is the Attorney General of Florida, appointed by Gov. Ron DeSantis in February 2025, and is the Republican candidate in the November 3, 2026 election for the office.
He grew up in Destin, graduated from the University of Florida and Georgetown Law, and is an adjunct professor at the University of Florida Levin College of Law.
Before his appointment he was DeSantis's chief of staff and general counsel, and earlier served as senior counsel and advisor at the U.S. Department of Commerce from 2017 to 2019.
He began his career as a litigation associate at Jones Day in Washington, D.C.
